sanitizedEvidence.summary: The user confirmed the exact reviewed trial and current physical baseline. A persisted fresh metadata/process/service preflight found the exact pad control collection, zero AppEngine, zero USBPcapCMD and zero active Razer-named services. The sole retained handle is admitted by exact host/SKU and pad revision/geometry; strict controller checks repeat before each exchange.

One typed run completed the fixed five-exchange sequence: query0000, set0300 with exact echo, query0300, immediate set0000 with exact echo, final query0000. Shared-session validation accepted prefix zero, 91-byte Windows framing, 90-byte body, checksum, transaction/command/status correlation and exact two-byte payload shapes. No envelope or native completion trace was independently captured.

After the trial, the operator confirmed normal unchanged fan and full-brightness static-green lighting, with no flashing-red or sleep indication. Synapse and the two previously authorized stopped Razer services were not restarted; no additional service stop was performed.

productionAdmission.reason: The exact-device typed mode-family round trip restores the saved raw baseline by readback. It does not assign laptop mode, fan state, RPM or ownership semantics, validate standalone Auto release, or admit production mutation.

limitations: This is a hashed typed result, not a PCAP. Raw response envelopes and native completion traces were not retained; exchange acceptance is reported by the reviewed shared session.

Only this immediate mode-only round trip was tested. It does not establish safe fan or lighting handback, sustained ownership, reconnect, shutdown/crash, sleep/resume or changing thermal-load behavior.
Raw0000 and0300 remain pad-specific candidates. Acknowledgement and restored raw state do not establish firmware ownership or meaningful fan-state readback.
The captured vendor startup includes other initialization, fan and lighting exchanges that were not replayed. Their combined effects are not attributed to this mode-only trial.
The prior failed standalone0D/10:000600 release is not superseded. No fan, lighting or demand setter was performed.
Vendor services and Synapse remain stopped by explicit user preference. No permission to restart them or stop additional services is inferred.

No serials, full device paths, process IDs or unrelated payloads are included. Operator physical confirmation is separate from raw protocol restoration; no vendor UI, fan-target or tachometer readback was obtained.
